_comment: Emory CHoRUS, X-ray subset. Internal Emory data: it is not public, and you must not share it. Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source (2026-11-05): the manifest CSV of the X-ray subset (one row for each DICOM file, 13,611 rows, 6,094 studies, 1,496 patients), read with pandas. The chest filter keeps a row when modality is DX or CR and the body part or the study description holds CHEST: 10,290 rows. Every row is DX and MONOCHROME2. image_path and sop_uid are unique. PatientSex is M or F. PatientAge is whole years (16 to 89, no blank in the chest rows). The subset has no labels, masks, boxes or reports. harmonizer_args gives the manifest to the harmonizer, so the test does not scan the DICOM tree.
